prompt: In multi-turn Claude Code sessions, the checkpoint condensed at the end of a turn is sometimes incomplete: it contains earlier turns' content but none of the lines from the turn that just finished. First turns of a session are always captured fully; the loss only appears from the second turn onward and is intermittent, more frequent when turns finish quickly back-to-back. Diagnose the root cause and fix it with a minimal change.
brain_queries: checkpoint dropped the whole latest turn
lines missing from a saved checkpoint in later turns of a session
picked up leftover completion record from the prior turn
condensed snapshot ends at the previous turn
